messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected: high GPU queue and degraded capacity in eu-west-2 (gpu-cluster-23). Auto-remediation attempted but insufficient. Paging oncall.

carmen: seeing long inference queue, pod backpressure, and GPU util at ~98% on most nodes. autoscaler stuck at 0 new nodes. Logs show provisioning errors: "quotaExceeded" for instance type g5.

ben: ack. I'm switching traffic and truncating batcher windows to ease pressure. will try a soft-shift to eu-central-1 first (50% -> 80%). paging ben in case I need infra access.

ben: running rollout command:
```bash
redwood traffic shift --src eu-west-2 --dst eu-central-1 --percent 60 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: traffic-shift job started (job_id: ts-1760805123-01). Routing table updated for 60% of new requests. :gear:

jamie: quick note — network team reported transient BGP flaps earlier, may have contributed to node bootstrap failures. recommend immediate override of quota and manual node boot if shift doesn't reduce latency in 5m. Also propose paging tweak: page oncall immediately for region-capacity errors instead of grouped alerts.

carmen: I can patch the autoscaler to ignore the quota-check for a short window and force a scale-up to mitigate. patch command below (1hr window):
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch horizontalpodautoscaler gpu-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleUp":{"policies":[{"type":"Pods","value":10,"periodSeconds":60}]}}}}'
```

ben: did the shift drop queue? metrics show 40% reduction in pending requests so far, latency p50 down ~120ms. still some failed node boots but traffic move is buying us time.

carmen: applied autoscaler patch, triggered 6 new nodes. provisioning logs show success for 4/6, 2 failed due to quotaExceeded. opened ticket with cloud-support for quota bump.

jamie: agreed on paging tweak. I'll prepare a small incident-bot config change to escalate region-capacity alerts to P1 and reduce suppression window to 30m. will post PR to infra-config.

oncall-rotations: handing off in 50m to @ben -> please capture state and update runbook link in this thread before end of shift.

ben: copying summary to runbook and ops channel. quick checklist I'm leaving: 1) current traffic shift 60% eu-central-1, 2) autoscaler patch live, 3) quota ticket: CS-1123, 4) follow-up: add BGP health probe to provisioning.

carmen: I'll stay on until handoff complete. will add commands to rollback traffic if eu-central spikes. snippet:
```bash
redwood traffic shift --src eu-west-2 --dst eu-central-1 --percent 0
```

incident-bot: Mitigation in progress: partial traffic shift + autoscaler override. Incident severity: high. Next update in 15m or on changes.

ben: thanks team. leaving notes for handoff and will update oncall doc. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: traffic-shift job completed (job_id: ts-1760805123-01). final routed percent: 60 -> eu-central-1.

incident-bot: Resolved: queue metrics returned to normal and GPU util down to 55% in eu-west-2 after manual node boots and quota bump confirmation. Closing incident.
